question: can i add text in openshot video editor
response_text:
**Yes, you can easily add text in OpenShot Video Editor.** 

As a content creator in Great Britain, you will find OpenShot to be a free, open-source, and beginner-friendly option for basic titling. However, depending on your workflow and content goals, you might also want to explore more advanced industry tools.

Here is a complete guide on how to add text in OpenShot, alongside a breakdown of the best software tools and workflow methods currently dominating the creator economy.

---

### How to Add Text in OpenShot Video Editor

OpenShot offers two primary ways to add text: **Standard Titles** and **Animated Titles** (which require Blender to be installed).

1. **Standard Titles:**
   * Go to the top menu and select **Title** > **Title** (or press `Ctrl + T`).
   * Choose from a variety of built-in templates (plain text, lower thirds, callouts).
